lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso with relatively uniform spacing of approximately 40-60 pixels between the primary segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 8th line from the anterior, splitting in the upper quadrant of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed line segments observed in lines 4 and 5; line 10 terminates mid-torso before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots located on the posterior haunch, centered above the knee joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate-spiral trajectory; initial posterior-lateral sweep from the pedicle, transitioning to an anterior-medial inward curve at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between apical tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory tipping occupies approximately the terminal 8-10% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped facial chevron and two distinct white spots located on the lower mandible/cheek region.
